services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short_description: If your roof is nearing the end of its lifespan or has suffered extensive damage, a full roof replacement may be the best option — we'll work with you to determine the best roofing materials for your home and budget.
services.long_description: For over 20 years, Allabaugh Construction has provided full roof replacements across Northeast Pennsylvania and New Jersey, working with both modern and traditional materials — including architectural shingles and EPDM roofing systems — to deliver durable, high-quality results. Every replacement comes with a lifetime Manufacturer's Warranty and a 10-Year Workmanship Warranty.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short_description: Whether it's a small leak or significant storm damage, our roof repair crew inspects the damage, advises the best course of action, and provides a comprehensive estimate of the costs involved.
services.long_description: We're committed to providing fast, reliable roof repair services across Northeast Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Common repairs include leaky pipes, damaged flashing and chimney leaks, loose or curling shingles, wind damage, and rotting wood from prolonged moisture exposure. Our team inspects your roof, identifies the source of the issue, and provides a lasting solution.

services.title: Roof Maintenance
services.short_description: Regular roof maintenance is essential to prolonging the life of your roof and preventing costly repairs down the line.
services.long_description: Our maintenance program includes inspection of the roof surface, flashing, and interior; gutter cleaning; debris removal; damage assessment; a detailed roof health report; and recommendations for extending your roof's lifespan. We recommend having your roof inspected at least once a year or after severe weather events.

services.title: Siding
services.short_description: For a complete exterior makeover, a new siding installation elevates your home's curb appeal.
services.long_description: Allabaugh Construction provides professional siding installation as part of its full-service approach to home exteriors across NJ and NEPA, handling everything from remodeling to maintaining homes and businesses.

services.title: Gutters
services.short_description: Our team handles gutter repair and installation efficiently and seamlessly, keeping your home's drainage system functioning correctly.
services.long_description: Well-maintained gutters protect your property from water damage. We offer gutter repair and installation, gutter cleaning, and gutter guard installation to keep your home's drainage system working correctly year-round.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs repair or replacement?
faqs.a: Roof inspections by a professional can help determine whether your roof requires repair or replacement. Factors such as age, visible damage, and leaks will be considered when recommending a service.

faqs.q: How long does a typical asphalt shingle roofing installation last?
faqs.a: A roof's lifespan depends on the materials used and how well it has been maintained. With that said, asphalt shingle roofs generally last 20-30 years.

faqs.q: What is the best type of roof for my home?
faqs.a: The best roof for your home depends on factors such as your budget, the local climate, and your aesthetic preferences. Our team can help you determine the best roofing option for your needs.

faqs.q: How often should I schedule roof maintenance?
faqs.a: Regular roof maintenance is crucial for prolonging the life of your roof. Having your roof inspected at least once a year or after severe weather events is generally recommended.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost?
faqs.a: The cost of a new roof can vary based on factors like the size of your roof, the roofing material chosen, and any additional services needed. Consulting with a roofing contractor will provide you with an accurate estimate.

faqs.q: Will my new roof come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes, reputable roofing companies like Allabaugh Construction, LLC offer warranties on their workmanship and roofing materials. Discuss our warranty details with a roofing expert today.

faqs.q: What is the most common type of roof damage?
faqs.a: The most common types of roof damage include leaks, missing shingles, and water damage caused by poor ventilation or aging roofing materials.

faqs.q: If my roof is leaking, can I have it repaired, or will it need to be replaced?
faqs.a: Whether your roof needs repair or replacement depends on the extent of the damage. Our professional contractors can assess the situation and provide the appropriate solution for your specific roofing service needs.
